title: (unofficial) Plants for a Future Data
description: An unofficial PFAF snapshot. The plant index was refreshed on 2026-10-17; most descriptions date from 2022. details_scraped_at records individual detail refreshes and is null when the date is unknown.

columns.native_range: The current PFAF Native Range section; found_in is retained for compatibility.
columns.source_url: PFAF detail page used for this record.
columns.details_scraped_at: UTC ISO 8601 time of the last successful detail fetch. Null means unknown; cached responses do not advance this time.
